gw_register.description:
To register Home Assistant as a Gateway:

**Warning:** Close the ARGO app before clicking Submit.

1. Click **Submit** below.
2. **Within 30 seconds**, scan your physical **Master Card** on the lock.

The lock will blink green once the card is read successfully.

The same scan also turns on the lock's **Door Status Advice** setting, which makes it report door state in its Bluetooth advertisements. Home Assistant then follows the lock without ever connecting to it on a timer.

init.description:
Home Assistant always follows the door state the lock broadcasts in its advertisements, which is immediate and costs the lock nothing.

Turning this on adds a connection to the lock every 30 seconds to read the door state as well, for when the advertisements do not reach Home Assistant reliably — at the edge of Bluetooth range, or with no Bluetooth proxy nearby. It wakes the lock each time.

Neither route helps if the lock reports no door status at all: that needs a door sensor and the lock's **Door Status Advice** setting, which Home Assistant enables during setup and you can also turn on for the lock in the ISEO Argo app.
init.title: Door status updates
